design.dgp: scripts/statistical_correction/run_calibration.py::make_series(iid_gaussian): mean 12 + fixed monthly effects + slope * t/120, iid Normal(0, 0.25^2) errors, complete monthly support
design.point_model: SARIMAX exog=[intercept, elapsed decades, 11 monthly indicators], order=(0,0,0), seasonal_order=(1,0,0,12), trend='n', enforce_stationarity=True, enforce_invertibility=True, maxiter=200
design.seed_derivation: SHA256(namespace + '|' + role + '|iid_gaussian|' + slope formatted to 8 decimals + '|' + replicate), first 128 bits as unsigned integer
design.replicate_pairing: One generated series is reused for all three interval candidates at the same slope and replicate index. Each candidate independently fits the identical unrestricted SARIMAX point model.

candidates.confidence_interval: statsmodels two-sided 95% normal Wald interval from unrestricted SARIMAX parameter covariance
candidates.p_value: two-sided asymptotic normal Wald test from the same unrestricted SARIMAX fit

candidates.confidence_interval: same SARIMAX point estimate and standard error; two-sided Student-t critical value with df=n-rank(X)-k_dynamic; df=262 for the frozen design; the innovation scale parameter is not subtracted
candidates.p_value: two-sided Student-t test using the same statistic and df as the interval

candidates.confidence_interval: 95% likelihood-ratio interval obtained by inverting 2*(profile logLik(beta)-unrestricted logLik) against chi-square(1) 0.95; exact stationary Gaussian seasonal-AR(12) likelihood profiled over intercept/month effects, seasonal AR parameter and innovation scale
candidates.p_value: two-sided likelihood-ratio test at beta=0 using the same profile likelihood and chi-square(1) cutoff as the interval

acceptance_criteria.residual_dependence_diagnostic: Ljung-Box at 12 and 24 calendar-month lags; p < 0.01 flags a residual-dependence failure
acceptance_criteria.monte_carlo_intervals: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals for Type-I error, coverage and power; Student-t 95% intervals for continuous means
acceptance_criteria.candidate_gate: Every applicable frozen gate must pass at all three slopes; Type-I is evaluated only at slope zero. Power is reported with exact uncertainty but has no new acceptance threshold. Wald is a comparator and is ineligible for corrected-candidate freeze.
acceptance_criteria.selection_rule: Among corrected candidates only, freeze a candidate only if all applicable gates pass at every slope. If both corrected candidates pass, the predeclared tie-break is the lower-complexity finite-sample t interval. Development success is eligibility for independent confirmation, not validation or registry promotion.

resource_budget.preflight_decision: Start the full development screen only if the measured two-fold projection for all 9000 candidate-replicates is below both development hard caps and the preflight completed all 90 paired series. Otherwise report NOT_VALIDATED_RESOURCE_BOUNDED and do not start the main screen.

selection_and_confirmation.independent_confirmation: Not included in this protocol. A new candidate must first pass the full development gates, then its exact method/hash, acceptance criteria, and an untouched confirmation seed namespace must be frozen in a separate protocol before any confirmation run.
